app.name: Masarat

govt.title: Government Portal

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your own details, and your company's.
profile.companyHint: The company or transport office name printed on your manifests.
profile.carrierNote: The company name, address and TIN are printed on your manifests as the carrier. The address and TIN are needed before you can generate a bill ID.
profile.carrierReadOnly: Only members allowed to edit the company's details can change these.

fleet.title: Vehicles
fleet.subtitle: Register the vehicles in your fleet, with their registration number, type and carrying capacity.

empty.title: No vehicles yet
empty.body: Add your first vehicle to start registering trips and paying transport tax.

dialog.subtitle: Plate, registration number, type and carrying capacity.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this vehicle?
deleteDialog.body: The vehicle will be removed from your fleet. This cannot be undone.

fields.plateHint: Choose the state letters, then enter the series (1–99) and the number (1–99999).
fields.registrationNoHint: As written on the vehicle's registration (licence) document.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.subtitle: The drivers who drive your vehicles. Each trip names one, and their name and phone are printed on its manifest.

empty.title: No drivers yet
empty.body: Add your drivers so you can pick one when you register a trip.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this driver?
deleteDialog.body: The driver will be removed from your list. Manifests already issued keep their name and phone.

trips.title: Trips
trips.subtitle: Register trips and see the transport tax due on each one.
trips.created: Trip for {{plate}} saved as a draft. Amount due: {{amount}}.

empty.title: No trips yet
empty.body: Create a trip to calculate its transport tax.
empty.periodBody: Choose another month, or create a trip.

noVehicles.title: Add a vehicle first
noVehicles.body: Every trip is made by one of your registered vehicles.

form.title: New trip
form.subtitle: Enter the trip details. The trip cost and taxes are calculated as you go.
form.editSubtitle: Drafts can be changed until their bill ID is generated.
form.suggestedHint: Suggested from the distance at {{speed}} km/h. You can change it.
form.domesticOnly: Passenger trips are within Sudan only.

fields.branchPlaceholder: Choose the branch it's booked at

tax.title: Trip cost, taxes and fees
tax.distanceNote: Distance is estimated from city coordinates (straight line × {{factor}} road factor). Trip cost = rate × distance × quantity; the taxes are percentages of it, and the fees are fixed amounts.

details.title: Trip #{{id}}
details.subtitle: Created {{date}}
details.archived: This trip is in the archive (older than a month): it can be viewed and printed, not changed.

items.title: Cargo items
items.name: Description
items.chooseVehicle: Select a vehicle first. Its capacity limits what it can carry.
items.none: No cargo items were recorded for this trip.

deleteDialog.title: Delete trip #{{id}}?
deleteDialog.body: This draft and its cargo items will be deleted. This can't be undone.

documents.hint: Attach the shipment's documents (PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 20 MB). They're optional.
documents.title: Documents

list.search: Search by trip #, plate, or a whole name: city, driver, sender, receiver, passenger or item

passengers.name: Name
passengers.infantSeat: An infant has to be on the seat of a passenger with a ticket.

period.limit: A period of up to 92 days.

draft.body: Generate an E-Sali bill ID to pay this trip's taxes and fees. They're calculated at the current rates and fees when the bill is issued.
draft.govtBody: No bill has been generated for this trip yet.

missing.title: Complete the manifest before generating the bill ID:
missing.packing: Packing type and number of packages for every item
missing.passengers: At least one passenger with a seat
missing.passenger_ids: An ID number for every passenger with a seat

pending.label: E-Sali bill ID
pending.hint: Pay this bill ID from any mobile banking app (Bankak or another bank), then refresh to confirm the payment.
pending.notPaid: Not paid yet. The trip stays pending until the payment is confirmed.

paid.title: Tax paid
paid.body: E-Sali confirmed the payment. The electronic payment receipt and the authorized manifest have been issued.

header.ministry: Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning
header.title: Electronic Payment Receipt

certificate.footer: This receipt was issued electronically by the Masarat system and needs no signature or stamp.

manifest.title: Land Goods Movement Permit
manifest.name: Name
manifest.footer: Issued electronically by the Masarat system after the fees were paid with receipt {{receiptNo}}. Valid only with that receipt.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.scope: Tax collection across all transport companies
dashboard.subtitle: All transport companies · Updated {{time}}
dashboard.empty: No data for this period yet.

kpis.collectionRateHint: Paid share of the amount billed in the period

breakdown.companyUnavailable: not with a route or cargo filter

regenerate.title: Regenerate demo data?
regenerate.body: This deletes the demo fleet companies and all their vehicles, trips, bills, receipts and manifests, then creates them again with fresh dates. Anything added by hand to a demo company is deleted too; other companies' data is kept. Anyone signed in as a demo company is signed out.

taxes.title: Taxes and fees
taxes.subtitle: The taxes and fees on every bill: a tax is a percentage of the trip cost, a fee a fixed amount. Each has its own value for cargo and passenger trips.
taxes.appliesTo: Changes apply to bills issued from now on. Bills already issued keep the lines they were issued with.

example.cargo: On a trip cost of {{cost}}, a cargo trip pays {{amount}} in taxes and fees.
example.passenger: On a trip cost of {{cost}}, a passenger trip pays {{amount}} in taxes and fees.

search.label: Search trips
search.placeholder: Search by E-Sali bill ID, MNF-/MSR- number, trip #, plate, company or city
search.resultCountMore: More than {{count}} trips found. The newest {{count}} are shown: add a word, a number or a route to narrow the search.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: The dashboard as a PDF report, or the raw data as Excel or CSV. Exports are in Arabic.
export.reportNote: The report opens as a preview with the official letterhead; print it or save it as a PDF from there.
export.dataNote: Excel writes one sheet per dataset; CSV is UTF-8 and opens in Excel.
export.csvFolder: Several files (CSV for several datasets, or Excel and CSV together) download as one ZIP file.
export.includeIdNumbersHint: Personal data: only when the file needs them, and handle it with care.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How long documents stay valid after a trip's estimated arrival, and the average speed the trip form suggests the arrival from.
settings.marginHint: Hours after the estimated arrival, 0 to 720.
settings.speedHint: For the suggested arrival, 10 to 150 km/h.
settings.appliesTo: A new margin applies to documents issued from now on; documents already issued keep their validity.

report.title: Road Transport Tax Collection Report
report.footer: Prepared by the Masarat system from the records available when it was issued.

listView.noMatches: Nothing matches the search and filters.

shell.offline: Masarat can't be reached right now. Check your connection and try again.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This section couldn't be shown. Try again, or reload the page. Your saved data isn't affected.

hero.title: Pay transport tax and get your manifest in minutes
hero.subtitle: Masarat prices a trip's taxes and fees, issues an E-Sali bill you can pay from any bank, and then gives you the payment receipt and the authorized manifest, each with a QR code checkpoint officers can scan.

owners.title: For transport companies
owners.p1: Register trips with their vehicle, route, cargo, driver and documents
owners.p2: See the trip cost, taxes and fees before you pay
owners.p3: Pay the E-Sali bill from Bankak or any banking app
owners.p4: Download the payment receipt and the authorized manifest

govt.title: For government
govt.p1: Follow revenue, bills and trips across every transport company
govt.p2: Find any trip by bill ID, manifest number, plate or name
govt.p3: Set the tax percentages and fees, with every change logged
govt.p4: Export reports and data for review and audit

s1.title: Create the trip
s1.body: Enter the vehicle, route and cargo. Masarat calculates the trip cost, taxes and fees.

s2.title: Pay the bill
s2.body: Generate an E-Sali bill ID and pay it from Bankak or any other bank.

s3.title: Get your documents
s3.body: Once payment is confirmed, download the receipt and the authorized manifest, each with a QR code.

footer.tagline: Electronic manifest and transport tax system

verify.note: Checked {{time}}. Compare these details with the printed manifest.

notFound.body: This code doesn't match any authorized manifest. The document may not be genuine.

failed.title: Couldn't check this manifest
failed.body: Masarat can't be reached right now. Check your connection and try again.

subtitle.govt: Create accounts for your staff and manage who can use the government portal. Admins can manage these accounts.
subtitle.company: Your company's members. A clerk works at one branch; give each person the role that fits.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.body: They are signed out at once and can't log in until the account is enabled again. Their records stay.

enable.title: Enable {{name}}?
enable.body: They will be able to log in again with their current password.

resetPassword.title: Reset {{name}}'s password?
resetPassword.body: They are signed out and get a temporary password, which they must replace at their next login.

changeRole.title: Change {{name}}'s role
changeRole.body: What they can do changes at once.

issued.body: Give {{name}} this temporary password. It is shown only once; they must replace it when they first log in.
